input.credit: LibriSpeech (Panayotov, Chen, Povey and Khudanpur, 2015), from LibriVox public-domain audiobooks

encoder.aggregation: Binned attention: rows are the mean over the query positions in a bin; columns sum the attention mass over the key positions in a bin. Every row sums to 1. Bin vectors are the mean over the bin's positions.

vocabulary: ありがとうございました
ありがとうございます

notes: One unmodified eager float32 forward pass on CPU over the full 30-second input and the generated prefix.
All six encoder blocks, six decoder blocks and eight heads per attention are captured.
Encoder attention is stored binned over time (stated aggregation); every softmax ran over all 1,500 positions.
Decoder self-attention, cross-attention over all 1,500 encoder positions and full-vocabulary logits are stored at full resolution.
Logits are the raw model output. Greedy decoding also applied the generation config suppression rules.
